runStateHint.io-error: Paused on a storage I/O error. Resume once the storage is back.
runStateHint.internal-error: QEMU stopped on an internal error. Reset or stop it.
runStateHint.guest-panicked: The guest OS panicked. Reset or stop it.
runStateHint.watchdog: Paused by its watchdog. Resume, reset or stop it.
runStateHint.shutdown: The guest shut down; its QEMU process is still up. Stop or reset it.
runStateHint.debug: Halted by a debugger. Resume to continue.

bootLegacy: Proxmox boots this VM by its legacy boot setting ({{value}}): the devices ticked here. Changing the order saves it as an order instead.
bootLegacyDefault: No boot order is set, so Proxmox boots this VM by its legacy default (cdn): the devices ticked here. Changing the order saves one.

hardwarePanel.noNodeInThisCluster: No node in this cluster reports supporting {{name}}.
hardwarePanel.proxmoxCannotTakeAnEmpty: Proxmox cannot take an empty memory, and deleting it drops the VM to 512 MiB: enter an amount to save.
hardwarePanel.stillTakesSpaceOnIts: still takes space on its storage
hardwarePanel.passedThroughDirectlyOnlyRoot: Passed through directly; only root@pam can remove it, in Proxmox
hardwarePanel.usesAROMFileOnly: Uses a ROM file; only root@pam can remove it, in Proxmox
hardwarePanel.aHostSerialPortOnly: A host serial port; only root@pam can remove it, in Proxmox
hardwarePanel.type1WhatTheGuest: Type 1: what the guest reads as its system
hardwarePanel.changingTheSMBIOSUUID: Changing the SMBIOS UUID — the guest sees different hardware on next boot. This can deactivate Windows, and it breaks Veeam backup correlation, which matches Proxmox guests on exactly this value.
hardwarePanel.clearingThisRemovesTheSMBIOS: Clearing this removes the SMBIOS UUID, and Proxmox will generate a new one — the guest sees different hardware on next boot. This can deactivate Windows, and it breaks Veeam backup correlation, which matches Proxmox guests on exactly this value.
hardwarePanel.thisVMSIntelVIOMMU: This VM's Intel vIOMMU needs a q35 machine type, so saving this one removes it.
hardwarePanel.moveLabelEarlierInThe: Move {{label}} earlier in the boot order
hardwarePanel.moveLabelLaterInThe: Move {{label}} later in the boot order
hardwarePanel.thisWillPermanentlyDeleteSpan: This will permanently delete <volume/> from storage, along with all data on it. This action cannot be undone.
hardwarePanel.deletingReloadsThisVMS: Deleting reloads this VM's configuration; unsaved changes in this panel will be discarded. Save first to keep them.
hardwarePanel.whenTheRemovalAppliesOn: When the removal applies, on Save or at the next restart of a running VM, Proxmox deletes the drive's volume <volume/> from storage. The VM's cloud-init settings stay, and a cloud-init drive added again is generated from them.
hardwarePanel.memoryIsEmptySoSave: Memory is empty, so Save is held: enter an amount.
hardwarePanel.summaryRunning: {{vcpus}}, {{memory}} of memory, {{disks}} and {{nics}}. The VM is running, so hardware changes stay pending until it restarts.
hardwarePanel.savedSomeChangesNeedARestart: Saved. Some changes need a restart.

containerResourcesPanel.theSourceVolumeIsKept: The source volume is kept as an unused volume on this container. Remove it later to reclaim the space.
containerResourcesPanel.appliesAtOnceNotOn: Applies at once, not on Save. A volume can grow but not shrink.
containerResourcesPanel.name: Name
containerResourcesPanel.theVolumesMarkedForDeletion: The volumes marked for deletion are no longer on this container, so nothing was saved, and the panel reloaded, discarding any other unsaved changes.
containerResourcesPanel.nothingWasSavedThisContainer: Nothing was saved: this container's configuration changed while this was open, including what this Save changes. Cancel reloads it; then make your changes again.
containerResourcesPanel.theseVolumesChangedAfterThe: These volumes changed after the list was shown, so nothing was deleted. Check the list again.
containerResourcesPanel.thisContainerSConfigurationChanged: This container's configuration changed while this was open. Cancel reloads it, discarding the changes you have not saved.
containerResourcesPanel.savingWillPermanentlyDeleteEach: Saving will permanently delete each volume below from storage, along with all data on it. This action cannot be undone.
containerResourcesPanel.proxmoxCannotUnsetAContainer: Proxmox cannot unset a container's memory: enter an amount to save.
containerResourcesPanel.anUnusedVolumeStillTakes: An unused volume still takes space on its storage. Removing one deletes its data. Changes apply on Save.
containerResourcesPanel.waitingForTheMACAddress: Waiting for the MAC address Proxmox gives it; it can be edited once the configuration reloads.
containerResourcesPanel.proxmoxLetsOnlyRootPam: Proxmox lets only root@pam change FUSE, Keyctl, Mknod and the mount types, and Nexara connects with an API token. Set them in Proxmox, as root@pam.
containerResourcesPanel.onAPrivilegedContainerProxmox: On a privileged container Proxmox lets only root@pam change features, Nesting included, and Nexara connects with an API token. Set them in Proxmox, as root@pam.
containerResourcesPanel.memoryIsEmptySoSave: Memory is empty, so Save is held: enter an amount.
containerResourcesPanel.summaryRunning: {{cores}}, {{memory}} of memory, {{volumes}} and {{nics}}. The container is running: CPU and memory changes take effect at once, others may need a restart.

vmConfigConstants.controlsNestedVirtualizationSvmOn: Controls nested virtualization — 'svm' on AMD CPUs, 'vmx' on Intel. Use a CPU model similar to the host, with the same vendor, not x86-64-vX.
vmConfigConstants.activateAESInstructionSetFor: Activate AES instruction set for HW acceleration.
vmConfigConstants.notifiesGuestOSThatHost: Notifies guest OS that host is not vulnerable for Spectre on AMD CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.improvesSpectreMitigationPerformanceWith: Improves Spectre mitigation performance with AMD CPUs, best used with 'virt-ssbd'.
vmConfigConstants.improvePerformanceForNestedVirtualizatio: Improve performance for nested virtualization. Only supported on Intel CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.improvePerformanceInOvercommittedWindows: Improve performance in overcommitted Windows guests. May lead to guest bluescreens on old CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.allowsImprovedSpectreMitigationWith: Allows improved Spectre mitigation with AMD CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.requiredToLetTheGuest: Required to let the guest OS know if MDS is mitigated correctly.
vmConfigConstants.meltdownFixCostReductionOn: Meltdown fix cost reduction on Westmere, Sandy-, and IvyBridge Intel CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.allowGuestOSToUse: Allow guest OS to use 1GB size pages, if host HW supports it.
vmConfigConstants.allowsImprovedSpectreMitigationWith2: Allows improved Spectre mitigation with Intel CPUs.
vmConfigConstants.protectionForSpeculativeStoreBypass: Protection for 'Speculative Store Bypass' for Intel models.
vmConfigConstants.basisForSpeculativeStoreBypass: Basis for 'Speculative Store Bypass' protection for AMD models.

addDeviceMenu.whichNexaraCreatesNowEven: , which Nexara creates now, even if you then discard this change

addDeviceMenu.all14USBSlotsAre: All 14 USB slots are in use.
addDeviceMenu.spiceUSBRedirectionAllowsPassing: SPICE USB redirection allows passing host USB devices through the SPICE client.
addDeviceMenu.aPCIDeviceOfThis: A PCI device of this node
addDeviceMenu.thisClusterHasNoPCI: This cluster has no PCI mappings yet.
addDeviceMenu.pickAHostDeviceInstead: Pick a host device instead, and Nexara creates one.
addDeviceMenu.proxmoxPassesAPCIDevice: Proxmox passes a PCI device straight through only for root@pam, and Nexara connects with an API token, so the device goes through a cluster resource mapping
addDeviceMenu.proxmoxWillNotStartThe2: . Proxmox will not start the VM while the device is missing or no longer matches the mapping.
addDeviceMenu.all16PCISlotsAre: All 16 PCI slots are in use.

addDeviceMenu.biosWillBeSetTo: BIOS will be set to OVMF (UEFI) when an EFI disk is added.

addDeviceMenu.mappingNameTaken: A mapping named "{{newName}}" already exists for other hardware.

addDeviceMenu.couldNotListPciMappings: Could not list the cluster's PCI mappings.
addDeviceMenu.couldNotListPciMappingsReason: Could not list the cluster's PCI mappings: {{reason}}

cloudInitPanel.noCloudInitDriveDetected: No cloud-init drive detected. Add a cloud-init drive (IDE, SCSI, etc.) to this VM on the Hardware tab to configure cloud-init settings.
cloudInitPanel.whatTheGuestIsGiven: What the guest is given on its cloud-init drive: an account, its network and the keys that may sign in. Proxmox regenerates the drive when the VM next starts.
cloudInitPanel.theAccountCloudInitSets: The account cloud-init sets up. Empty keeps the image's default user.
cloudInitPanel.proxmoxStoresOnlyAHash: Proxmox stores only a hash, so the current one is never shown.
cloudInitPanel.theFirstInterfaceSAddress: The first interface's address: DHCP, or a static address and gateway.
cloudInitPanel.oneKeyPerLineThey: One key per line. They are added to the user's authorized keys.

snapshotPanel.noSnapshotsFoundTakeOne: No snapshots found. Take one before a risky change, so there is a state to roll back to.

overwriteNeedsDelete: Overwriting it needs the {{permission}} permission, which you do not have.
confirmActionMessage: Are you sure you want to {{action}} {{name}}? This action may cause data loss.
vmidWarning: VMID {{id}} may already be in use
haStoppedMigrateTitle: This guest is stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBody: Proxmox hands the move to the HA manager, which migrates a stopped guest offline later. If it cannot, the guest stays on {{node}} and only the HA log on that node says why, and the job ends as not moved. To move it now, start it and migrate it live.
haStoppedMigrateBulkTitle_one: {{count}} selected guest is stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBulkTitle_other: {{count}} selected guests are stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBulkBody: {{names}}. Proxmox hands each move to the HA manager, which migrates a stopped guest offline later. If it cannot, the guest stays where it is and only the HA log on its node says why, and its job ends as not moved. To move them now, start them and migrate them live.
destroyDesc: This will permanently destroy {{name}} and all its data. This action cannot be undone.
cloudInitNotDetected: No cloud-init drive detected. Add a cloud-init drive (IDE, SCSI, etc.) to this VM to configure cloud-init settings.
noScheduledTasks: No scheduled tasks for this resource.
